description:
## 1.10.2 (2026-11-06)

### ✨ New Features

* **nicoid:** Add an option to restore tab scroll positions after restarting the app.
* **nicoid:** Add an option to return to normal playback when switching back to the app. ([#111](https://github.com/chikuwadon/nicoid-re-patches/issues/111))
* **nicoid:** Add an optional confirmation dialog when exiting the app.
* **nicoid:** Add an option to inspect and delete video caches from the previous storage location.

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* **nicoid:** Fix missing move and remove actions in local playlist menus.
* **nicoid:** Fix missing thumbnails in local playlists.
* **nicoid:** Fix navigation drawer and Back button behavior in playlist screens.
* **nicoid:** Fix playlist lists not refreshing immediately after changes.
* **nicoid:** Fix scroll position restoration for initially opened tabs and asynchronously loaded lists.
* **nicoid:** Fix status bar spacing after exiting fullscreen playback.

### 🔧 Improvements

* **nicoid:** Improve vertical gesture recognition while preserving normal scrolling behavior. ([#109](https://github.com/chikuwadon/nicoid-re-patches/issues/109))
* **nicoid:** Improve background playback transitions when returning to the app.
* **nicoid:** Improve tab scroll restoration and reduce unnecessary retries.
* **nicoid:** Simplify Back button behavior when using multiple tabs.
* **nicoid:** Show cache size and file counts before deletion, and report the actual freed space afterward.
* **nicoid:** Improve playlist thumbnail loading and reduce redundant list updates.
* **nicoid:** Refine settings organization, descriptions, and dynamic updates.
* **nicoid:** Improve localization of MP4 storage settings.
* **nicoid:** Optimize settings screen lifecycle handling and memory usage.
